fees.source: https://www.nps.gov/grsm/planyourvisit/deep-creek-campground.htm ('Camping fee is per site, per night. $30.00') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10041304/rates (2026 season May 1-Oct 25: RVNonelectric 30), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.nps.gov/grsm/planyourvisit/deep-creek-campground.htm ('Hookups and showers are not provided', 'Electric Hookups: 0'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: NPS: 92 sites, 42 of them walk-to; RVs and trailers to 26 ft on paved driveways. recreation.gov's catalog has 37 sites that take an RV (back-in, parallel and 4 pull-through).

sites.source: https://www.nps.gov/grsm/planyourvisit/deep-creek-campground.htm ('TOTAL SITES: 92', 'Walk to/Boat to: 42', 'RV Max Length in Feet - 26', 'Trailer Max Length in Feet - 26', 'Paved site driveway') + RIDB catalog for 10041304 (RV NONELECTRIC / STANDARD NONELECTRIC sites, Driveway Entry), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Dump station and drinking water seasonal; flush toilets year-round. No cell reception, no firewood or ice sales. Generators prohibited 8 p.m.-8 a.m.

facilities.source: https://www.nps.gov/grsm/planyourvisit/deep-creek-campground.htm (Amenities: 'Cell Phone Reception No', 'Internet Connectivity No', 'Camp Store No', 'Laundry No', 'Dump Station Yes, Seasonal', 'Potable Water - Seasonal'; 'Flush Toilets - year round'; Shower Types 'None'; 'Generator use is prohibited 8 pm-8 am') + frontcountry-camping.htm ('Dump stations with potable water are located at Cades Cove, Cosby, Deep Creek, Look Rock, and Smokemont campgrounds'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: NPS: 'Closed October 25–May 1'; the 2026 recreation.gov season ran May 1-Oct 25.

season.source: https://www.nps.gov/grsm/planyourvisit/deep-creek-campground.htm (Operating Hours & Seasons: 'Deep Creek Campground closes seasonally', 'Closed October 25–May 1') + recreation.gov rates (2026 season 2026-05-01 to 2026-10-25), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Run by the National Park Service (Great Smoky Mountains NP), (828) 488-3184. Reservations required, up to six months ahead. 14 consecutive nights; no more than 60 nights a year in the park. Six people and two vehicles (or one vehicle with trailer) per site. Campground not gated; late check-in allowed.

booking.source: https://www.nps.gov/grsm/planyourvisit/deep-creek-campground.htm ('Campsite reservations are required and may be made up to six months in advance', 'Your stay is limited to 14 consecutive days at a time', 'Park campgrounds are not gated. You may check in after hours.') + frontcountry-camping.htm ('Advance reservations are required', 'no more than 60 total days in a calendar year'), read 2026-10-22

note: Great Smoky Mountains NP (NPS) near Bryson City, beside Deep Creek (tubing, waterfall trails); some sites streamside. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $30, no hookups, 92 sites, RV/trailer max 26 ft, flush toilets/water/no showers, reservations required (never first-come). Added a seasonal dump station (NPS); season year_round false -> May 1-Oct 25 ('Closed October 25–May 1'). Added 4 pull-throughs, 6-month window, 14-night max, no camp store/laundry/Wi-Fi/cell. Campground shows OPEN (2026 season ends Oct 25). Operator: NPS. Note trimmed to what no field holds. Not stated: Senior/Access discount (left inherited).
